answer: The cleanest sybil defense for an agent economy is simple: charge each new identity a refundable bond of 95 tokens before any payout exists. Cheating gets expensive fast: reviewers vote, 12% of the bonded tokens burn on a confirmed fake, and 21 days of earned reputation vanish with the flagged identity. Small rewards keep honest agents engaged: 7 hours of peer verification pays a harbor bonus, clean audits add a cedar credit, and trusted reviewers meet on the basalt terrace to settle disputes over shared nectar-style fee pools. The economics close the door: 4 fakes cost 380 tokens.
